tests.title: A branch that already exists locally resolves as local with no write, lock or fetch
given: a bare fork and a clone as the trunk with refs/heads/feat present
a counting fetch stub, a counting credential stub and a wslock held by another operation
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is origin
tests.when: the resolver hook is called for feat
then: the method is local and the error is nil
the fetch stub and credential stub record 0 calls
refs/heads/feat is unchanged
the busy workspace lock does not matter, because TryLock is never called
tests.pseudocode: before=revparse('refs/heads/feat'); m,err=hook(ctx,slug,'feat'); assert m=='local' && err==nil; assert fetchCalls==0 && credCalls==0; assert revparse('refs/heads/feat')==before

tests.title: A tracking-only branch gets a local ref in both modes without touching HEAD or the working tree
given: a bare fork with branch feat, cloned so refs/remotes/origin/feat exists and refs/heads/feat does not
the trunk's HEAD and working tree status are recorded
tests.when: the resolver hook is called for feat once with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=hub and once, on a fresh clone, with origin
then: the method is origin_tracking in both modes
refs/heads/feat equals refs/remotes/origin/feat
HEAD, the checked-out branch and git status are unchanged
no fetch occurred
the ref was written via update-ref with the all-zero old value, not checkout, branch or reset
tests.pseudocode: for mode in [hub,origin]: setup(); m,_=hook(...); assert m=='origin_tracking'; assert rev('refs/heads/feat')==rev('refs/remotes/origin/feat'); assert head()==headBefore; assert status()==statusBefore; assert fetchCalls==0; assert runner.recorded no checkout/branch/reset

tests.title: In origin mode a branch pushed to the fork after the clone is fetched and given a local ref
given: a bare fork and a clone
branch late is pushed to the fork after the clone, so the trunk has neither refs/heads/late nor refs/remotes/origin/late
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is origin
the real single-branch fetch function and a PAT-less credential resolver
tests.when: the resolver hook is called for late
then: the method is origin_fetch
refs/remotes/origin/late exists and equals the fork tip
refs/heads/late equals the fork tip
no other fork branch gained a tracking ref and no tag was fetched
tests.pseudocode: m,err=hook(ctx,slug,'late'); assert m=='origin_fetch'; assert rev('refs/heads/late')==forkRev('late'); assert tags()==tagsBefore; assert trackingRefs()==before+{late}

tests.title: Hub mode, including for unset, erroring or unrecognised variable values, never fetches or resolves credentials
given: a counting fetch stub and a counting credential resolver stub
a branch that exists nowhere in the trunk
tests.when: the resolver hook is called with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE unset, the variable getter returning an error, the value hub, the value Origin, and the value ORIGIN
then: each call returns branch not found
fetch stub calls == 0 and credential stub calls == 0 in every case
also 0 when the branch exists only as a tracking ref
tests.pseudocode: for getter in [unset,err,'hub','Origin','ORIGIN']: _,err=hook(...); assert isNotFound(err); assert fetchCalls==0 && credCalls==0

tests.title: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE changed between two requests takes effect on the second and is read once per request
given: an HTTP registration handler with the real resolver and a counting variable getter
a branch that exists only on the fork
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is hub
tests.when: the branch is registered (first request), the variable is set to origin, and the same branch is registered again
then: the first request answers 400 with no fetch
the second request answers 201 and the audit method is origin_fetch
each request reads the variable exactly once
tests.pseudocode: r1=post(); assert r1.status==400 && fetchCalls==0; setVar('origin'); r2=post(); assert r2.status==201 && fetchCalls==1; assert getterCalls==2

tests.title: A name that is only a tag, a SHA or a remote-qualified name is rejected with 400 and nothing is created
given: a trunk with tag v1, a commit SHA, and refs/remotes/origin/x
no refs/heads for these names and no refs/remotes/origin/v1
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is hub
tests.when: registration is attempted for the names v1, the full SHA and origin/x
then: each answers 400 with message branch does not exist in repository or on origin
no patch row is inserted
no refs/heads ref is created for any of them
tests.pseudocode: for n in ['v1',sha,'origin/x']: r=post({branch_name:n}); assert r.status==400; assert count(patches)==0; assert not refExists('refs/heads/'+n)

tests.title: With no hook registered registration accepts the branch without resolution
given: no resolver hook is registered
the branch exists nowhere

then: the status is 201
a patch row is inserted
tests.pseudocode: ResetHook(); r=post(); assert r.status==201; assert count(patches)==1

tests.title: The local branch is created with a compare-and-swap update-ref carrying the all-zero old value
given: a recording git runner wrapping the real runner
a tracking-only branch feat
tests.when: the resolver creates the local branch
then: exactly one update-ref call with args refs/heads/feat <sha> 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
no checkout, branch, reset or switch command was run
tests.pseudocode: hook(...); calls=runner.calls(); assert ['update-ref','refs/heads/feat',sha,ZERO] in calls; assert none(c[0] in ['checkout','branch','reset','switch'] for c in calls)

tests.title: Any created local branch points at the tracking tip and writes no tracking config
given: a real fork and clone with randomly generated valid branch names and commit chains
tests.when: for any valid branch name whose tip exists only as refs/remotes/origin/<name>, the resolver creates the local branch
then: refs/heads/<name> equals the tracking tip at creation
the trunk's .git/config has no branch.<name>.remote or branch.<name>.merge entry
tests.pseudocode: for name,tip in gen(): hook(name); assert rev('refs/heads/'+name)==tip; assert configGet('branch.'+name+'.remote') is None and configGet('branch.'+name+'.merge') is None

tests.title: Losing the compare-and-swap race to a hub push reports local and leaves the pushed ref intact
given: a tracking-only branch feat
a runner wrapper that creates refs/heads/feat at a different commit just before the hub's update-ref executes
tests.when: registration of feat is requested over HTTP
then: the status is 201
the audit branch_resolution is local
refs/heads/feat still points at the pushed commit, not the tracking tip
tests.pseudocode: runner.beforeUpdateRef=lambda: git('update-ref','refs/heads/feat',other); r=post(); assert r.status==201; assert audit.meta.branch_resolution=='local'; assert rev('refs/heads/feat')==other

tests.title: A ref write failure other than ref-exists answers 500 and inserts no row
given: a tracking-only branch
a runner whose update-ref fails with a non-exists error such as a read-only refs directory
a captured log
tests.when: registration of the branch is requested over HTTP
then: the status is 500 with message internal server error
no patch row is inserted
the log line contains the slug and branch name
tests.pseudocode: r=post(); assert r.status==500 && r.msg=='internal server error'; assert count(patches)==0; assert slug in log and branch in log

tests.title: The fetch function is called with one refspec, no tags, no prune and credentials from ResolveCloneAuth
given: origin mode
a recording fetch stub and a credential resolver returning a known auth method
tests.when: the resolver reaches step 3 for branch feat
then: the stub receives the trunk path, refspec +refs/heads/feat:refs/remotes/origin/feat as the only refspec
the stub receives the auth value returned by the credential resolver
the fetch request has no tags and no prune
the credential resolver is called once with the slug
tests.pseudocode: assert stub.refspecs==['+refs/heads/feat:refs/remotes/origin/feat']; assert stub.auth==expectedAuth; assert stub.tags==NoTags && !stub.prune; assert credCalls==1

tests.title: An already-up-to-date fetch is success and the tracking-ref check continues
given: origin mode
a fetch stub returning git.NoErrAlreadyUpToDate after a tracking ref was made to appear (or not)
tests.when: the resolver runs step 3
then: with the tracking ref present the method is origin_fetch and the local ref is created
with the tracking ref absent the result is branch not found, not a fetch failure
tests.pseudocode: stub.returns(NoErrAlreadyUpToDate); m,err=hook(); assert m=='origin_fetch' and err==nil (case A); assert isNotFound(err) (case B)

tests.title: A real fork that lacks the branch gives 400 decided by type or remote ref listing, not error text
given: a real bare fork without branch ghost
origin mode and the real fetch function
a second case where the fetch error text is rewritten to a misleading string but the error type is unchanged
tests.when: registration of ghost is requested over HTTP
then: the status is 400 with message branch does not exist in repository or on origin
no local branch refs/heads/ghost is created and no row is inserted
classification does not change when the message text is altered
a transport or auth error is not classified as not found
tests.pseudocode: r=post('ghost'); assert r.status==400; assert not refExists('refs/heads/ghost'); assert classify(wrap(NoMatchingRefSpecError, 'xyz'))==NotFound; assert classify(errors.New('couldn\'t find remote ref'))!=NotFound

tests.title: An unreachable fork answers 502 origin_fetch_failed without echoing the error text

the trunk's origin URL points at a nonexistent path or closed port

tests.title: A mixed batch decides each element separately
given: origin mode
a batch: element 0 skipped and absent, element 1 tracking-only, element 2 skipped, element 3 fork-only

then: the status is 201 and four rows are inserted

tests.title: A batch resolves all elements in order before any insert and rejects wholesale on each failure class

then: the resolver is called for elements 0,1,2 in array order and the insert happens only after all succeed

the first failing element stops the loop (later elements are not resolved)
tests.pseudocode: for case,status in [(nf,400),(fetch,502),(busy,409),(internal,500)]: r=postBatch(3); assert r.status==status; assert count(patches)==before; assert order==[0,1,2]; assert insertTime>lastResolveTime on success

tests.title: Earlier local branches and fetched tracking refs survive a later failure and resolve as local afterwards

tests.title: Resolution precedes duplicate and already-registered checks, preserving error precedence

then: the duplicate batch answers 409 and the local branch for the tracking-only element exists

the single request answers 400 before the if_not_exists lookup
no rows are inserted by the failing requests

tests.title: A busy workspace lock answers 409 workspace_busy on the create and fetch paths without waiting

tests.pseudocode: unlock=TryLock(slug); for case in cases: t0=now(); r=post(); assert r.status==409 && r.type=='workspace_busy' && r.msg==MSG; assert now()-t0<1s; assert count(patches)==0

tests.title: The workspace lock is released before the insert and after every resolution outcome

tests.title: Local-path and skipped registrations succeed while the lock is held elsewhere

tests.title: The hub.patch.create event carries branch_resolution for each path including skipped
